packagecaches.name: Package caches
packagecaches.gradle_daemon: A Gradle daemon is running. Stop it with ./gradlew --stop or close Android Studio, then rescan.
packagecaches.npm.title: npm
packagecaches.npm.what: Copies of every npm package you have installed, plus packages that npx downloaded to run a command once.
packagecaches.npm.why: Packages are downloaded from the registry again when a project needs them. Installed node_modules folders keep working.
packagecaches.npm.after: The next npm install downloads packages instead of copying them from the cache.
packagecaches.yarn.title: Yarn
packagecaches.yarn.why: Yarn downloads packages again when a project needs them.
packagecaches.yarn.after: The next yarn install will be slower.
packagecaches.cocoapods.title: CocoaPods
packagecaches.cocoapods.what: Downloaded pods and the specs repository that pod install uses.
packagecaches.cocoapods.why: Pods already installed into ios/Pods keep working. CocoaPods downloads what it needs again.
packagecaches.cocoapods.after: The next pod install downloads pods again.
packagecaches.gradle.title: Gradle
packagecaches.gradle.what: Dependencies, build transforms, Gradle distributions and the archives Gradle unpacked JDKs from, downloaded for Android and Java builds.
packagecaches.gradle.why: Gradle downloads everything again on the next build. It can't be cleaned while a Gradle daemon is running.
packagecaches.gradle.after: The next Android build downloads dependencies and takes several minutes longer.
packagecaches.uv.title: uv
packagecaches.uv.what: Python packages and wheels downloaded by uv.
packagecaches.uv.why: uv downloads them again when a project needs them. Existing virtual environments keep working.
packagecaches.uv.after: The next uv sync or uv pip install will be slower.
packagecaches.pip.title: pip
packagecaches.pip.why: pip downloads them again when needed. Installed packages keep working.
packagecaches.pip.after: The next pip install will be slower.
packagecaches.homebrew.title: Homebrew
packagecaches.homebrew.what: Bottles and source archives that Homebrew downloaded while installing or upgrading.
packagecaches.homebrew.why: Installed programs don't need these files. Homebrew downloads them again if it needs to reinstall.
packagecaches.go.title: Go
packagecaches.go.what: Compiled packages (build cache) and downloaded modules of Go projects.
packagecaches.go.why: Go rebuilds the cache and downloads modules again on the next build.
packagecaches.go.after: The first build of each Go project will be slower and needs the internet.
packagecaches.swiftpm.title: Swift Package Manager
packagecaches.swiftpm.what: Repositories of Swift packages cloned for your Xcode projects.
packagecaches.swiftpm.why: Xcode clones packages again when it resolves dependencies.
packagecaches.swiftpm.after: The next package resolution in Xcode will take longer.
packagecaches.browsers.title: Browsers for testing
packagecaches.browsers.what: Chrome, Firefox and WebKit builds downloaded by Puppeteer and Playwright for automated tests.
packagecaches.browsers.why: They are copies of public browser builds and can be downloaded again.
packagecaches.browsers.after: Tests and tools that drive a browser stop working until you reinstall browsers, for example with npx playwright install.
packagecaches.electron.title: Electron
packagecaches.electron.what: Electron binaries downloaded while building or packaging desktop apps.
packagecaches.electron.why: They are downloaded again when a project needs them.
packagecaches.electron.after: The next Electron build or package step will download them again.
packagecaches.expo.title: Expo
packagecaches.expo.what: App builds that Expo installs into simulators, Expo Go downloads and Android APKs.
packagecaches.expo.why: Expo downloads or builds them again the next time you run a project.
packagecaches.expo.after: The next npx expo run or opening Expo Go downloads them again.
packagecaches.jstools.title: JavaScript tools
packagecaches.jstools.what: Prebuilt React Native and Hermes archives, TypeScript type definitions for the editor, pnpm metadata, node-gyp headers, dotslash downloads, Prisma engines and Corepack package managers.
packagecaches.jstools.why: Each tool downloads its files again when it needs them.
packagecaches.jstools.after: The next pod install of a React Native project or the next native module build takes longer.
packagecaches.nuget.title: NuGet
packagecaches.nuget.after: The next build of a .NET project downloads packages first.
packagecaches.python.title: Python bytecode
packagecaches.python.what: Compiled .pyc files of the Python that comes with Xcode command line tools.
packagecaches.python.why: Python compiles them again on the next run.
packagecaches.python.after: The first run of Python scripts is a little slower.
packagecaches.precommit.title: pre-commit
packagecaches.precommit.what: Environments that pre-commit installs for git hooks (linters and formatters of each repository).
packagecaches.precommit.why: pre-commit installs them again the next time hooks run.
packagecaches.precommit.after: The first commit in each repository with hooks takes longer while they are installed.
